notes.title: Controller configuration
notes.notes:
You can configure the controller inside the launcher that opens once the game is executed. In it you can map all the buttons in Keyboard, Keyboard+Mouse, Xbox controller, Playstation controller or Generic pc Controller

If you still find troubles you can use the explicative images and the "readme" file inside the game's installation folder (default C/programfiles/steam/steamapps/common/cursed west)

If even so you still got any troubles you  can comunicate with me using Cursed West's Steam comunity. which was created for this kind of problems or write me directly in my mail mentioned in the instructions Text file
